body: 拍摄一张竖幅纪实人像：一位虚构的年长渔民坐在海港修网棚门口，一只小型杂毛犬靠着他的靴子休息。阴天柔光，视线与人物平齐，自然皮肤纹理，衣服有盐渍与使用痕迹，色彩克制，轻微胶片颗粒，背景能看见虚焦的渔网。避免摆拍姿势和过度磨皮。

en.description: An older fisherman repairs a net with a small dog resting beside his boot
en.body:
## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt. No reference image is required. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

An older fisherman repairs a net with a small dog resting beside his boot. Natural skin and fabric detail, subdued light; the dog is close to the lower edge.

## Source and generation

The source provides an original prompt; this production uses the separately recorded working prompt. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#control-style-and-lighting). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.
